name: fivedrisk
description: 5D Risk Governance Engine for Claude Code. A deterministic policy gate: a PreToolUse hook scores every tool call on 5 dimensions (Data, Tool, Reversibility, External, Autonomy), bands it GREEN/YELLOW/ORANGE/RED, and enforces the verdict — GREEN/YELLOW execute, ORANGE blocks pending approval (exit 2), RED is denied. A PostToolUse hook scans tool output for leakage/injection-echo. Every decision is logged to a local SQLite audit trail. No LLM in the decision path; policy is configurable via policy.yaml.
